title: L'Hopital's rule
text: Treat $$n$$ as a continuous variable $$x$$. The limit of $$\frac{\ln\left(x\right)}{x}$$ has the form $$\frac{\infty}{\infty}$$, so differentiate the top and bottom.

title: Derivative ratio
text: After differentiating, the expression becomes $$\frac{\frac{1}{x}}{1}$$. What is its limit as $$x$$ goes to $$\infty$$?
